messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from the DR postmortem — we need a compact owner/timeline list for the remediation items and a small game-day to validate restores + routing. Can owners call dibs?

sam: I can own multi-region routing checks (DNS failover, route weights, BGP health). Deliverable: checklist + test plan by Thu EOD. :thumbsup: 

alex: I'll take backups & snapshot verification. Plan: add automated snapshot validation to the runbook and a smoke-recovery script. Will prototype by Wed.

jordan: Assign me for restore runbook edits and playbook clarity (step-by-step for on-call). I’ll incorporate alex's smoke script into the runbook. ETA next Monday.

ops-bot: Action created: #DR-842 routing-checklist assigned to sam, due 2771300000.

maya: Thanks — pairing notes: sam + emily for routing, alex + jordan for restore/backup automation. We should also capture recurring incident patterns (DNS flaps during maintenance windows).

emily: I’ll co-own routing tests. Proposed quick tests:
- Route53 failover simulation (change health check to fail)
- BGP withdraw test in staging-visible colo
- Validate latency-based routing fallback under traffic spike

sam: For the Route53 test, recommend this command for scripted failover simulation:
```bash
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z123 --change-batch file://failover.json
```
I’ll add a canned failover payload to the repo.

alex: Backup verification idea: nightly restore-to-temp cluster and run checksum validation. Quick command snippet for snapshot list: `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-prod-backups/ | tail -n 20`

maya: Game-day scheduling — propose a 2hr window next Thu 16:00 UTC. Objectives: run routing checklist, validate 1 restore from latest snapshot, verify failover metrics. Who's available?

jordan: I can make the Thu slot. I’ll bring the runbook draft to the session.

emily: I’m available, will bring monitoring dashboards and alert runbooks.

sam: Available but need 30m heads-up for BGP test prep.

alex: Can do, will prepare the smoke-recovery script and a teardown step.

maya: Great — owners & due dates recap:
- Routing checklist (sam + emily) — due 2771290000
- Backup verification automation (alex) — due 2771250000
- Restore runbook edits (jordan) — due 2771350000
- Game-day (maya) — scheduled 2771366400 (Thu 16:00 UTC)

ops-bot: Note: recurring-incident tag added to thread. Reference: postmortem DR-2025-03.

sam: One more: add synthetic user traffic during game-day to validate caching/KV warmup. I’ll draft a small k6 script and share.

maya: Perfect. I’ll update the action tracker and ping owners 48h before the game-day. If anything slips, call it out in this thread so we can reassign. :eyes:
